limits: The check runs against a temporary source tree; no native plugin build was run here (it needs the runtime archives). Digests are of canonical source skills, not packaged bytes, because packaging rewrites skill names.
outcome: passed: plugin_package.check_lightning_promotions reads the committed export integrations/lightning-promotion/registry-export.json and compares each mapped canonical source SKILL.md with its registry's active candidate; a promoted file passes a release build. A hand-edited file yields lightning-promotion-mismatch: <scope> expected <sha> actual <sha>, returned as a warning for a local build and raised for a release build (OD-2). With no active candidate the file must equal the baseline the scope's first decision names in its lightning-baseline: limit (expected <baseline sha>); an override reason's digest cited by the same decision is not a baseline. Negative controls: no export is not checked; missing file (actual missing); invalid export; unknown scope in an export; non-canonical export bytes; scripts/build_native_plugin.py calls the check with release unless --allow-dirty.
